verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only installation: a marketplace add/install command, pasting a SKILL.md into a chat, or copying folders into .claude/skills/. Nothing documents an update command, marketplace auto-update behavior, or any way to get fixes without reinstalling. Any update mechanism the Claude Code plugin marketplace itself provides would be a host-platform capability, not one this product documents.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch
